known.evidence: Trace log examines get_prep_lookup's wrapping of every value in Value(...) and concludes 'No defect found'; never mentions iterators or the rhs being consumed twice by any().

other.summary: User-supplied non-JSON Value() (e.g. Value('x'), Value(1)) in a JSON __in list is now wrapped as JSON on MySQL/Oracle (JSON_EXTRACT('x','$') / JSON_OBJECT ... FORMAT JSON), causing invalid-JSON errors; the old KeyTransformIn skipped anything with as_sql
other.reason: JSONIn.resolve_expression_parameter adds `or isinstance(param, expressions.Value)`. Value('x') infers CharField and compiles to '%s',['x'], which then goes into JSON_EXTRACT(%s,'$') on MySQL or JSON_OBJECT(... FORMAT JSON) on Oracle. Old code skipped params with as_sql. The new tests use only Value(..., JSONField()).

known.evidence: Flags get_prep_lookup only for wrapping every plain value as Value(v, lhs.output_field) and related-field serialization; nothing about a generator/iterator rhs being consumed by any() before the comprehension.

other.summary: get_prep_lookup now wraps all plain values when an expression is present; related-field __in mixing F()/Subquery with model instances could fail since ForeignKey.get_db_prep_value may not accept instances
other.reason: RelatedIn.get_prep_lookup runs when rhs_is_direct_value() (true for a list with F()), normalizes model instances to pks via get_normalized_value and runs the target field's get_prep_value before calling super(), so instances never reach Value().

other.summary: JSONIn.process_lhs wraps a top-level LHS (JSON_EXTRACT / SQLite JSON_TYPE CASE / Oracle COALESCE) even when the RHS is a subquery, which could break json_field__in=Model.objects.values('json_field')
other.reason: process_lhs wraps the LHS regardless of RHS type, and a subquery RHS never goes through resolve_expression_parameter. Reproduced on SQLite: the wrapped LHS IN (SELECT v ...) matched only '14' of 4 rows (objects, strings and lists are lost because JSON_EXTRACT returns minified or unquoted text). The raw comparison matched all 4.
The review itself calls it harmless for lists; no reachable failure.

other.summary: as_oracle JSONNull detection relies on Value equality and bare None becomes Value(None, JSONField) rather than JSONNull
other.reason: Speculative fragility or a question about intent; BaseExpression equality is identity-signature based and works for JSONNull().

known.evidence: Trace row on get_prep_lookup wrapping says 'no defect found'; no mention of the rhs iterable being iterated twice.

other.summary: Oracle JSONIn.as_oracle returns an unparenthesized '(a) OR (b)' chain, so ANDed sibling filters bind wrongly and return wrong rows
other.reason: as_oracle returns ' OR '.join(sql_parts) without outer parentheses. WhereNode.as_sql joins children with ' AND ' without wrapping each child. In.split_parameter_list_as_sql wraps its OR chain in parentheses. Reachable with JSONNull() in the list on Oracle with supports_primitives_in_json_field.

known.evidence: Minor point on get_prep_lookup only notes that every plain value is now wrapped in Value(v, lhs.output_field) and asks for tests with F() mixed with ints, dates and FKs; does not identify the iterator being consumed by any().

other.summary: Oracle OR expansion for JSONNull in JSONIn.as_oracle is not parenthesised; filter(value__in=[JSONNull(), [1]], pk=1) compiles to (a) OR (b) AND pk = 1
other.reason: Same check as C: no outer parentheses in as_oracle, and WhereNode joins children with AND unwrapped.

other.summary: get_prep_lookup now wraps all plain values (not only str) in Value(v, lhs.output_field) for all fields; custom get_prep_value/get_db_prep_value behaviour unconfirmed
other.reason: Unverified speculation with no concrete failure; Value.as_sql still calls get_db_prep_value, which runs get_prep_value.

other.summary: test_in lacks top-level scalars (string, int, bool) and None
